title: Not only is Lake Powell's water level plummeting because of drought, its total capacity is shrinking, too
contentSnippet: Lake Powell, the second-largest human-made reservoir in the US, has lost nearly 7% of its potential storage capacity since 1963, when Glen Canyon Dam was built, a new report shows.
